forenza_island_10.m: I don't think you want to do that.

forenza_island_100.m: I was only allowed to go after mother insisted to father that I go too.
r: What happened to skipping the details?

forenza_island_110.m: OK...Gylew and father discovered this story of looted gold coins that were rumored to be hidden here in the Laeroth Manor. But neither was strong enough to dare try to retrieve it.

forenza_island_120.m: For many years afterwards, this is all the family ever talked about. During this time, my father and I grew apart and eventually, my mother and I left him and returned to her hometown of Brightport.

forenza_island_130.m: I was able to make it back to him shortly before his death in an attempt to repair our broken relationship.
r: What happened to skipping the details?

forenza_island_140.m: Angry with him, I was able to steal this key [Forenza shows you what you suspect is the key to the chest] from his estate before it was given to Gylew.

forenza_island_150.m: A few years later I learned what this key opened and this is why I am here. To my disappointment, I quickly realized I was missing the second key.
r: Where do you think the other key is?
[Sarcasm] I like the 'stories with Grandpa hour'. But seriously, skip the details and tell me where the other key is.

forenza_island_160.m: Isn't it obvious? Gylew must have it.
r: You have been wronged by your family and deserve this treasure. I can get Gylew's key for you.
Gylew is the rightful owner of his father's estate and that key belongs to the estate.

forenza_island_170.m: You will do this for me?

forenza_island_170_attack.m: What are you going to do about it?
r: Kill you and take that key!

forenza_island_180.m: Great. Go to Gylew and get his key. Then bring it and the chest to me. I will meet you outside of Brimhaven.

forenza_island_20.m: Well, for starters, that chest that you are carrying belongs to me.

forenza_island_30.m: Because I said it does! Now give me that chest before you get hurt.
r: Don't make me laugh. You hurt me? Do you know who I am? Explain yourself now.
Explain yourself now or Gylew gets his treasure.

forenza_island_40.m: The story starts many many years ago.
r: [You rudely interrupt] Oh great, please spare me the grandpa story.

forenza_island_50.m: Anyways...it was back when we were kids. You see, Gylew and I are half-brothers.

forenza_island_60.m: We have the same father. After Gylew's mom died of the Great Plague, father traveled to Brightport in search of a new wife.

forenza_island_70.m: To "spare you of the grandpa story" as you called it, I will skip details.

forenza_island_80.m: Eventually, they were married and I was soon born. Gylew and I were close in age and often got along great.

forenza_island_90.m: But father always favored Gylew. They often took long trips in search of exotic and unique coins. I was left out of these adventures most of the time.

forenza_island_initial_phrase.m: What do you think you are doing here?
r: Returning to Gylew what is rightfully his.
I am working a job for a man name Gylew.
Um...I am returning something to a man named Gylew.

forenza_island_injured.m: Hey, you. I need your help!
r: What? Who are you? How did you get in here?

forenza_island_injured_explained.m: Seriously?! Can't you see that I am bleeding and weak?
r: Well, I have this ointment for stopping wounds. Take it.
What do you want? A healing potion maybe?

forenza_island_injured_help.m: Please. I'll take whatever you have that could heal me.
r: Well I have a bonemeal potion. It's yours now. Take it.
Well I have a special bonemeal potion. It's yours now. Take it.
Here, take it. It's a really strong potion of healing.
I have this really special potion of healing that I got from a very wise old man. Take it!
I have an ordinary potion of health for you. Take it!
I have an little health potion for you. It's all I have. Take it!
I'm so sorry, but I have nothing that can help you.

forenza_island_injured_help_lph.m: Oh, now this stuff feels like its healing power will last just a little bit longer.

forenza_island_injured_help_minor_ph.m: Oh, this should help. I guess.

forenza_island_injured_help_mph.m: This stuff tastes nasty, but I swear I can feel it helping already.

forenza_island_injured_help_rph.m: Oh, this should help. Thank you.

forenza_island_injured_need_help.m: Nerver mind that now. I am injured and I need your help!
